The PKGBUILD contains only standard variable assignments in global scope and defines a `latestver()` helper function that is never called. No `pkgver()` function exists (pkgver is hardcoded), so no network requests or code execution occur during sourcing. The `source` array points to the official upstream domain (unmined.net) with a valid sha256sum. The `prepare()` and `package()` functions are not executed due to `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`. Running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will only fetch and verify the .deb file, then source the PKGBUILD — no malicious code runs.
</details>
